mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_conversations (session_id, user_email, title, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{userEmail}, #{title}, datetime('now'), datetime('now'))
INSERT INTO rag_messages (conversation_id, role, content, sources, created_at) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{sources}, datetime('now'))
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id AS sessionId, user_email AS userEmail, title, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM rag_conversations WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
SELECT id, session_id AS sessionId, user_email AS userEmail, title, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM rag_conversations WHERE user_email = #{email} ORDER BY updated_at DESC
SELECT id, conversation_id AS conversationId, role, content, sources, created_at AS createdAt FROM rag_messages WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY created_at ASC
